pool.rule: chapters 1..780 of the snapshot minus the 31 dev chapters minus the 100 chapters of the base chapters file (649 chapters)

signal_a.name: non_person_weak_spans
signal_a.rule: number of positive spans whose type is not person in the weak S3 labels of the chapter (data/weak_labels/20261003-weak_v2/labels_S3.jsonl, split train; the record checks the file sha256 against runs/20261003-weak_v2/config.json). Pool spread when the rule was written: median 7, 90th percentile 20, max 39; the top 100 cut at 17.

signal_b.name: student_uncertainty
signal_b.rule: the three A2 models (runs/20261004-tag-T-s1-s1base, runs/20261004-tag-T-s2-s1base-e60, runs/20261004-tag-T-s3-s1base; the stage 1 teacher-label arm) predict every pool chapter (ordinary predict runs on training chapters, run ids <model run>-predict-pool649); per chapter u = (spans of the three seeds union that not all three seeds predicted + spans all three predicted whose lowest seed score is below 0.9) / (spans in the union); a chapter with fewer than 10 union spans gets u = 0 (too few to rank). This is LLMaAA-style uncertainty sampling on training text only: no answer file, dev2, test or test2 is read.
signal_b.value_rule: signal_b = uncertain_spans / union_spans (0 when union_spans < min_union_spans); ranked on the exact quotient, stored rounded to 4 decimals

selection_rule: list A = the 100 pool chapters with the highest signal_a (ties: lower chapter number first); list B = the 100 chapters with the highest signal_b among the pool minus list A (ties: lower chapter number first). The 200 new chapters = A then B, in that order, 5 per pack: packs teach_b21..teach_b40 are list A sorted by signal_a descending, teach_b41..teach_b60 list B sorted by signal_b descending. The record stores both signals for every pool chapter, the cut values, and the strata distribution (the 8 ranges of the base config) of the 200.

cut.note: the signal value of the last chapter of each list (100 per list)

overlap.note: list_a_in_top_by_signal_b: how many of A would also be in the top by signal_b over the whole pool; list_b_with_signal_a_at_cut_a: B chapters that missed A only by the tie rule
